hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qEi '\.env(\.[a-z]+)?"|\.pem"|\.key"|\.cert"|\.p12"|\.pfx"|/\.ssh/|/\.aws/|/\.gnupg/|supabase/config\.toml"|integrations/supabase/client\.ts"|integrations/supabase/types\.ts"'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked: writing to credential/secret file, or to an auto-generated Supabase file. Regenerate types from the Supabase dashboard instead."}'; else echo '{"decision": "allow"}'; fi

INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qEi 'git\s+push\s+(-f|--force)|npm\s+publish|docker\s+push|supabase\s+db\s+reset'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked: destructive or irreversible operation. Get explicit user approval first."}'; else echo '{"decision": "allow"}'; fi
